oln3qi.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.
In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.
For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
oln3qi.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

拉亚利科学家们正努力解决再生技术失效的问题。目前，他们的工作因缺乏材料而受阻，他们认为这些物资可能对他们的实验至关重要。

特别是，我们在 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的科学家们因耗尽这些资源而不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的常规供应商数月内无法供货，因此我们将为任何能协助补充这些物资的人提供丰厚报酬。

有关这些动物的更多信息，请参阅您日志中的《探险家的可采集物指南》。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

1ja362d.description_en:
Hi,
Another day another beacon. There's a [SHIP] looking to be topped up with [FUELTYPE] at [LOCATION]. The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.
If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.
Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say.
Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.
Just do the job and get home safe, okay?
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
1ja362d.description_zh:
嗨，

又是新的一天，又有一个信标。在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 那边有一艘 <EM4>[SHIP]</EM4> 希望能补充 [FUELTYPE]。客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

我也不骗你：那地方一旦被困住可不好受，要是被偷袭就更糟糕了。我们在那儿已经损失了不少人 - 哪怕是运气好活下来的，回家时也缺胳膊少腿的。

如果你决定接这活儿，帮我个忙，时刻提高警惕。如果你有个朋友正好有空，不妨叫上他搭把手做点支援。

也许是我多虑了，但这并不意味着他们不会找你麻烦，正如德洛特妈妈常说的那样。
其实她从来没说过这话 - 不过我敢打赌，如果她靠这个谋生，她肯定这么说。

把活儿干完，平安回家，好吗？

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

Well done!
With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.
This next section will help you familiarize yourself with [LOCATION] and take you to visit [STORENAME], a weapons store here in [LOCATION].

During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.

12qno4i.description_en:
Hey!
DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.
The UWC offers repair, rearming and refueling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refueling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.
And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.
If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out.
A Club member has run out of [FUELTYPE] at [LOCATION]. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.
The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST]. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their [SHIP] and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a journal entry on your mobiGlas called "Refueling Protocols" that covers the basics.
There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates.
Looking forward to working with you.
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
12qno4i.description_zh:
嘿！

我是来自旅者联合俱乐部的 DD。

UWC 在全 UEE 范围内提供维修、补给和加油服务。碰巧我们正在寻找新的合作伙伴，只要你的飞船配备了加油设备。如果你拥有燃料吊舱，并且喜欢被人热情迎接，那么 UWC 可能很适合你来。

如果你觉得这不错，那我手头正好有一个正在运行的信标你可能喜欢。

如果你确实喜欢它，那么给你一个提醒：<EM4>出发前务必确保燃料吊舱已满</EM4>。

一名俱乐部成员在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 那边耗尽了 [FUELTYPE]。具体细节我还不太清楚，比如他们怎么就跑到那儿连“动力果汁”都没了，但 UWC 不想把大家晾在一边不管。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

这是一趟很简单的活儿。如果你想感受熟悉这类工作，这再合适不过了。去那里给他们的 <EM4>[SHIP]</EM4> 加满油，然后让他们启程吧。多做几次这样的任务，操作就会变成肌肉记忆。在此之前，你的 mobiGlas 里有一篇名为“加油协议”的<EM4>日志条目</EM4>，涵盖了所有基础内容。

该区域尚未报告有不法分子活动，但仍需保持警惕。我始终建议你追求快速周转。越早完成，我就越能尽快为你安排下一份合约。UWC 一直在寻找新的合作伙伴。

期待与你合作，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”
